purpose: Deterministic, evidence-bounded comparison surface between Public Law 119-38 requirements and observed justice.gov release artifacts.

scope.law: Public Law 119-38, Epstein Files Transparency Act
scope.target_surface: justice.gov/epstein and DOJ publications concerning the Epstein Files Transparency Act

knobs.name: ENACTMENT
knobs.requirement: Public Law 119-38 is the governing statute for this knob set.

knobs.name: RELEASE_DEADLINE_30_DAYS
knobs.requirement: Release required not later than 30 days after enactment.

knobs.name: SEARCHABLE_FORMAT
knobs.requirement: Covered release must be publicly available in searchable format.

knobs.name: DOWNLOADABLE_FORMAT
knobs.requirement: Covered release must be publicly available in downloadable format.

knobs.name: ALL_UNCLASSIFIED_COVERED_RECORDS
knobs.requirement: Scope covers all unclassified covered records in DOJ possession, subject to permitted withholdings.

knobs.name: FBI_INCLUDED
knobs.requirement: FBI records are expressly within covered DOJ possession.

knobs.name: USAO_INCLUDED
knobs.requirement: United States Attorneys' Offices are expressly within covered DOJ possession.

knobs.name: EPSTEIN_INVESTIGATION_PROSECUTION_CUSTODY
knobs.requirement: Epstein investigations, prosecutions, and custodial matters are covered.

knobs.name: MAXWELL_MATERIALS
knobs.requirement: Ghislaine Maxwell materials are covered.

knobs.name: FLIGHT_TRAVEL_RECORDS
knobs.requirement: Flight logs and travel records are covered.

knobs.name: NAMED_REFERENCED_INDIVIDUALS
knobs.requirement: Individuals named or referenced in specified Epstein-related contexts are covered.

knobs.name: RELATED_ENTITIES
knobs.requirement: Specified corporate, nonprofit, academic, or governmental entities are covered.

knobs.name: DEALS_AND_SETTLEMENTS
knobs.requirement: Specified immunity, non-prosecution, plea, and sealed-settlement materials are covered.

knobs.name: INTERNAL_DOJ_CHARGING_COMMUNICATIONS
knobs.requirement: Internal DOJ communications about charging/investigative decisions are covered.

knobs.name: DESTRUCTION_ALTERATION_CONCEALMENT_METADATA
knobs.requirement: Specified records about destruction, deletion, alteration, misplacement, or concealment are covered.

knobs.name: DETENTION_DEATH_RECORDS
knobs.requirement: Specified detention and death records are covered.

knobs.name: NO_EMBARRASSMENT_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Embarrassment is prohibited as a withholding/delay/redaction basis.

knobs.name: NO_REPUTATIONAL_HARM_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Reputational harm is prohibited as a withholding/delay/redaction basis.

knobs.name: NO_POLITICAL_SENSITIVITY_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Political sensitivity is prohibited as a withholding/delay/redaction basis.

knobs.name: VICTIM_PRIVACY_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Segregable victim PII/private-file material may be withheld or redacted under the statute.

knobs.name: CSAM_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: CSAM may be withheld or redacted.

knobs.name: ACTIVE_INVESTIGATION_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Active-investigation/prosecution withholding must be narrowly tailored and temporary.

knobs.name: DEATH_ABUSE_INJURY_IMAGES_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Images of death, physical abuse, or injury may be withheld or redacted.

knobs.name: CLASSIFIED_INFORMATION_WITHHOLDING
knobs.requirement: Properly classified national-defense/foreign-policy information may be withheld or redacted.

knobs.name: REDACTION_JUSTIFICATION_PUBLICATION
knobs.requirement: Redactions require written justification published in the Federal Register and submitted to Congress.

knobs.name: MAXIMUM_DECLASSIFICATION
knobs.requirement: Covered classified information must be declassified to the maximum extent possible.

knobs.name: UNCLASSIFIED_SUMMARY_IF_NOT_DECLASSIFIED
knobs.requirement: If covered classified information cannot be released, an unclassified summary is required.

knobs.name: POST_JULY_1_CLASSIFICATION_DISCLOSURE
knobs.requirement: Post-July 1, 2025 classification decisions require Federal Register publication and congressional submission with specified metadata.

knobs.name: REPORT_TO_CONGRESS_15_DAYS
knobs.requirement: Within 15 days of completion of the required release, the Attorney General must submit the Section 3 report.

knobs.name: REPORT_RELEASED_WITHHELD_CATEGORIES
knobs.requirement: The Section 3 report must list categories of records released and withheld.

knobs.name: REPORT_REDACTION_SUMMARY_LEGAL_BASIS
knobs.requirement: The Section 3 report must summarize redactions including legal basis.

knobs.name: REPORT_OFFICIALS_PEPS
knobs.requirement: The Section 3 report must list government officials and politically exposed persons named or referenced in released materials.

evaluation_rules.pass: Requires evidence sufficient to show the specific statutory requirement was met for the evaluated observation scope.
evaluation_rules.fail: Requires evidence sufficient to show the specific statutory requirement was not met for the evaluated observation scope.
evaluation_rules.unresolved: Default. Evidence is incomplete, ambiguous, not yet bound, or not yet evaluated.
evaluation_rules.not_applicable: Requirement does not apply to the evaluated observation.
